# evalshift-sdk

> In-process Python capture SDK for AI agents. Wrap an agent's entry point, tool calls, and model calls; each run is recorded as a structured trace and written as a JSON capture file to `.evalshift/captures/<suite>/cap_<id>.json` on local disk. Capture is off unless the `EVALSHIFT_CAPTURE` env var is truthy. Zero runtime dependencies (stdlib only), Python >= 3.10, no network code unless `EVALSHIFT_SINK` names an object store you own. Captures are consumed by the separate [evalshift CLI](https://github.com/evalshift/evalshift-cli); the capture layout is the interface between SDK and CLI, on disk or in a bucket.

Key facts:

- Distribution name is `evalshift-sdk`; import name is `evalshift`. Current version 0.5.0, envelope schema version 2.1.0.
- Top-level public API: `capture` (with `.agent`, `.agent_session`, `.agent_session_async`, `.model_call`, `.tool`), `record_model_call`, `configure`, `Redactor`, `RedactSetting`, `default_redactor`, `FileSink`, `MemorySink`, `ObjectStoreSink`, `flush_captures`, `load_capture`, `load_envelope`, `register_migration`, `MigrationError`, `SCHEMA_VERSION`, `__version__`. LangChain adapter: `evalshift.adapters.langchain.EvalShiftCallbackHandler` (needs the `[langchain]` extra). Provider client wrappers: `evalshift.adapters.openai.wrap_openai`, `evalshift.adapters.anthropic.wrap_anthropic`, `evalshift.adapters.genai.wrap_genai` (extras `[openai]`, `[anthropic]`, `[google-genai]`) — a drop-in proxy over a client instance that records one `model_call` per request inside a capture session. Object stores: `evalshift.stores` (`ObjectStore`, `MemoryStore`, `open_store`, `parse_store_uri`) plus `evalshift.stores.s3.S3Store` / `.gcs.GCSStore` / `.azure.AzureBlobStore` (extras `[s3]`, `[gcs]`, `[azure]`).
- Redaction is required, not opt-in: `redact=` is a mandatory keyword on `capture.agent`, `capture.agent_session`, `capture.agent_session_async`, and `EvalShiftCallbackHandler` — `True` masks with `default_redactor`, `False` captures verbatim, a callable is your own redactor; anything else (including `None`) raises `TypeError`. There is no `configure(redact=...)`.
- Safety model: the capture path is fail-open (SDK faults can never break or slow the host agent; failed runs are still captured, then the original exception re-raises); redaction is fail-closed (a raising redactor drops the capture rather than writing unredacted data); the read path (`load_capture`/`load_envelope`) raises typed `MigrationError` subclasses.
- Hygiene defaults keep `captures/` bounded: dedup on (per-process, keyed `(suite, input_hash)`), newest-200 files kept per suite. Configurable via `configure(...)` or `EVALSHIFT_MAX_CAPTURES` / `EVALSHIFT_DEDUP` / `EVALSHIFT_CAPTURE_TTL` / `EVALSHIFT_SAMPLE_RATE`; capture root via `EVALSHIFT_DIR`.
